title: group_matches_pattern uses simplified glob, not wildmat
description: In crates/transit/src/main.rs, the function group_matches_pattern (line 1094) implements only a trailing-star prefix match, not the full wildmat algorithm. It is used to decide which pinning services receive a CID for external pinning. However, ExternalPinServiceConfig.groups is documented as 'Patterns are matched against each newsgroup' with the example comp.*, implying full wildmat semantics. An operator who uses ? or a mid-pattern * in a pinning service group filter will get incorrect results silently — the function will not match as expected. The GroupFilter abstraction and matches_wildmat function already exist in stoa_core. group_matches_pattern should either be replaced with matches_wildmat, or the documentation should be made unambiguous that only trailing-* prefix matching is supported and the config field should be named accordingly.
